name: Get Member Account Count
description: Logs into the Corevance Core Banking Admin, searches for a member by numeric member ID, and reports the number of accounts held by that member (as shown in the Accounts table on the Member Detail page).

member_id.description: Numeric member identifier to search for

accounts_table_text.description: Raw tab-separated text of the member's Accounts table (header + one row per account). Caller can count rows/lines to get the number of accounts, or parse account details.

business_outcomes.message: Login was rejected due to invalid credentials.

steps.intent: Enter the member ID to search for

business_outcomes.message: No member exists with the given member ID.

steps.intent: Read the Accounts table to determine number/details of accounts held by the member

locator.description: Accounts table on member detail page

candidates.note: The bordered inner table listing Account Number/Type/Opened/Balance columns

business_outcomes.message: The member holds no accounts; the Accounts table is empty or absent.
